completedItems: Added a draft-first source file pipeline that creates ExtractedSourceDraft before any review.
Added ProtectedSourceFileMetadata as a metadata-only protected record linked to UploadedSourceFile.
Separated Sprint 5 file failure classifications into metadata missing, unreadable, protected, and unsupported-manual-review categories.
Added human review application that creates StructuredResponse only after approved_for_structured_response.
Added browser-safe preliminary reading for text-like files and manual-review fallback for unsupported/protected files.
Connected official assessment uploads to editable draft review before structured output.
Connected additional source uploads to editable draft review before structured output.
Guarded goal-building context so only reviewed and approved file pipelines can support goal authoring.
Updated Sprint 2 verification to require draft pipeline creation plus human review instead of the older direct pipeline builder.
knownDeferredWork: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, and image OCR parsing remain manual-review fallback in this sprint; production-grade parsers and AI-assisted extraction belong to a later governed stage.
